purpose: Define the acceptance contract for the future mecha_engine.generation package module before moving generator code out of labs/grid_genome.

external_references.title: Procedural Content Generation in Games
external_references.used_for: Generator evaluation categories and PCG research framing.

external_references.title: WaveFunctionCollapse reference implementation
external_references.used_for: Local-similarity, observation-propagation, and contradiction-handling reference behavior.

required_public_surface.name: train_generation_model
required_public_surface.contract: Train a constrained generation model from valid seed grids without mutating inputs.

required_public_surface.name: generate_candidate
required_public_surface.contract: Generate one valid grid candidate from a valid parent, optional SLIP profile, and deterministic RNG seed.

required_public_surface.name: generate_batch
required_public_surface.contract: Generate exactly count valid, traceable candidates with unique candidate IDs.

required_public_surface.name: explain_generation
required_public_surface.contract: Return JSON-serializable trace data for lineage, constraints, validation, and SLIP alignment.

model_acceptance: Reject seed corpora containing invalid grids.
Preserve enough local-pattern evidence for constrained generation.
Record model metadata sufficient to identify the training corpus and generator strategy.
Do not expose raw Markov output as the sole production path.
candidate_acceptance: Require a parent grid that passes mecha_engine.genome.validate_grid.
Return a grid genome that passes mecha_engine.genome.validate_grid.
Preserve parent_grid_id, lineage generation, and ancestor IDs.
Include mutation or generation events in lineage metadata.
Support deterministic output for the same parent, model, SLIP profile, and RNG seed.
Return a candidate ID stable enough for batch traceability.
Do not mutate the parent grid, model, or SLIP profile.
batch_acceptance: Produce unique candidate IDs within the batch.
Produce deterministic batches for the same inputs and RNG seed.
Validate every returned candidate through the package genome API.
Beat the random mutation validity baseline of 42 valid candidates per 100.
Reproduce the constrained generator gate of 100 valid candidates per 100 before package promotion.
Reproduce the SLIP-constrained gate of 50 valid and aligned candidates per 50 when a valid SLIP profile is supplied.
slip_acceptance: Validate the profile before candidate generation.
Fail clearly if no seed or parent grid can satisfy the profile.
Return alignment evidence in the generation explanation.
negative_checks: package tests mutate sys.path to reach labs
raw Markov output is treated as the production generator without validation or constraints
invalid candidates are silently dropped without trace data
generated candidates omit lineage or parent information
generated candidates mutate seed, parent, model, or SLIP inputs
package documentation claims full Wave Function Collapse adoption without entropy-selection, propagation, and contradiction-handling tests
future_verification_commands: python -c "from mecha_engine.generation import train_generation_model, generate_candidate, generate_batch, explain_generation"
next_research_step: Use this gate as the generation acceptance checklist when the user explicitly starts package scaffold or generation package work.
